g.text: Top: bars = pooled mean, diamonds = pooled p95; independent y scales. Headline runs have profiling disabled.
Profile: separate 120-frame runs, last 90 frames shown; subphases sum to velocity-inverse total only.
Pool entry is inside the baseline inverse timer and outside the optimized inverse timer; whole-frame timing includes both.
Same-socket physical cores, non-exclusive host. Initialization, output and rendering excluded from frame timing.
